sourceText: User directed continued execution until every milestone in docs/requirements/decisions/role-prompt-modularization-and-budget-execution-plan.md is DONE. Story 1 requires Runtime Contract, Role Contract, Prompt Envelope data structures, measurement sidecars, a frozen 16-role lifecycle registry, deterministic bytes/lines/token/repetition algorithms, and unchanged existing assembled Prompt outputs.
normalizedOutcome: The read-only prompt_measurement_report visibly reports an exact 16-role lifecycle partition and reproducible contract/prompt cost metrics with unknown layers marked unavailable, while the approved 16 agent_prompt output hashes remain unchanged.
acceptanceClaim: Story 1 is accepted when versioned contract schemas and the exact 12-active/3-compatibility/1-retired registry produce a deterministic measurement sidecar/report, all mutation probes fail closed, and every existing agent_prompt output remains byte-identical.
